remarks: This beautifully updated condo is a light filled unit that combines modern living with unbeatable convenience. It's situated within walking distance to restaurants, shops, the hospital and close to I95. The living space is bright, has brand new carpet and is freshly painted creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The kitchen is updated with white cabinets and stainless steal appliances-including a dishwasher. The updated bathroom has extended counter space and modern wall paper. This rare unit also comes with a PRIVATE GARAGE offering secure parking and some additional storage options. HEAT & HOT WATER INCLUDED!
